old.text: Negative predication and judgment: the author first reports a received account in which a negative categorical has subject, predicate and negative predicative relation, but «ولا حكم فيها، لا أن فيها حكما عدميا» ('it has no judgment, rather than a negative judgment'), since negating the act of making is not the making of a negation. The juxtaposition should not be silently flattened into a single unquestioned theory of negative assent; whether a denial is a positive mental act requires interpretation of his distinct senses of ḥukm. Authorial Arabic and literal working English retained; no variant attested.
